name: Restaurant manager
summary: Keeps service smooth and food cost in line with checklists, prep lists, station guides and costed recipes. Shows which dishes earn their place.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources (FSA, FDA Food Code and allergens, EU 1169/2011, Square, Toast, Google, FTC, CMA, working time rules), four skills, five prompts, three workflows, training interview and test briefs, and access levels per tool. Stock orders and supplier contracts need a fresh yes each time.
